name: BoardEffect
description: BoardEffect is Diligent's board management platform for meetings, agendas, board books, minutes, documents, workrooms, calendars, directories, surveys, voting, assessments, goals, reports, and governance collaboration.
agentUseSummary: BoardEffect advertises product integrations and historically announced custom applications through an API, but its current public first-party surface does not publish a distributable customer authorization, endpoint, permission, or lifecycle contract. Relay therefore mounts no connection or tools.

blocked.label: Connect a BoardEffect organization
blocked.description: BoardEffect does not publish a current distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract for third-party access to an organization.

blocked.label: Read BoardEffect data
blocked.description: Meetings, agendas, books, minutes, documents, workrooms, calendars, directories, surveys, votes, assessments, goals, reports, users, permissions, and audit data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change BoardEffect
blocked.description: Meeting preparation, publishing, uploads, minutes, surveys, voting, workrooms, goals, permissions, user administration, exports, and every mutation remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled without a reviewed, distributable BoardEffect customer API or hosted MCP contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No current BoardEffect customer authorization contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No current BoardEffect customer authorization contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: BoardEffect currently advertises product-native connections with applications including Google Drive, Microsoft Azure, and Salesforce. A first-party 2016 integration announcement also said custom applications would connect through an API, but the reviewed current public first-party surface does not provide a distributable authorization method, organization or API origin, least-privilege scopes or roles for automation, endpoints or tool schemas, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect behavior, or non-production contract. BoardEffect governs confidential board, healthcare, donor, client, and financial records with layered permissions, so private-endpoint or browser automation is not an acceptable substitute.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request BoardEffect login credentials or show Connect, and do not automate its web or mobile clients. Coordinate with Diligent or BoardEffect for a current distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract, then review exact tenant and server origins, authentication, least-privilege permissions, tools or endpoints and schemas, pagination and rate limits, webhook behavior, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, and non-production test access before reconsidering support.

evidence.supports: BoardEffect's current product page documents meetings, agendas, board books, minutes, documents, workrooms, calendars, directories, surveys, voting, assessments, goals, and reports, and advertises native connections with Google Drive, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce, and other applications without publishing an external customer API contract.

A first-party 2016 announcement described an integrations panel for SSO and GoToMeeting and said custom applications would connect through an API, but it does not define a current distributable authorization, endpoint, permission, or lifecycle contract.

BoardEffect documents confidential donor, client, financial, healthcare, meeting, directory, and report data protected by three in-product layers and role-based document access, supporting critical risk and fail-closed handling.
BoardEffect documents administrator workflows for agendas, approvals, documents, meetings, minutes, surveys, and board-cycle administration whose read and mutation surfaces cannot be inferred safely.
BoardEffect's privacy link resolves to Diligent's current privacy notice covering account, product, usage, device, support, and customer-provided information across Diligent services.
